summary: Frontend-only testing of the token-billing wording update on /vs/* (devin, cursor, github-copilot, replit-agent, windsurf, vibe-coders), /compare and /about on preview (VITE_TOKEN_BILLING_MODE=on). Checked visible body text with all FAQ <details> expanded, the feature-matrix rows, CTAs, meta description and JSON-LD. Tested navigation through /compare cards and 'More comparisons' links (all 6 slugs plus the hub), and did a quick homepage check. Ran a separate production build with VITE_TOKEN_BILLING_MODE=on plus seo-prerender.mjs in /tmp, not touching /app/frontend/dist, and grepped the static snapshots. Ran the 2 new Vitest files (6/6 pass). Almost everything passes: the Pricing model and Free tier rows are token-based on all 6 pages, the FAQ answers use token wording, the /compare CTA reads 'Start free — get your score', the /about paragraph is correct, there are no console errors and routing works. Found 2 leftover ungated strings in competitors.mjs that still say 'flat tasks'. They show on the live page and in the built SEO HTML.

ui_bugs.issue: This string isn't gated: 'The real comparison is metered requests vs flat tasks, and assistance vs delegation.' It shows in token mode on /vs/github-copilot (visible intro and the dist/vs/github-copilot/index.html snapshot). It implies per-task billing, which contradicts the token model.

The FAQ question is 'How does effort-based billing compare to AUREM's flat tasks?'. Only the answer is gated, not the question. It shows in the visible <summary>, in the FAQPage JSON-LD, and twice in dist/vs/replit-agent/index.html.

action_items: Gate the github-copilot intro in competitors.mjs: in token mode, replace 'metered requests vs flat tasks' with e.g. 'metered requests vs a flat monthly price'.
Gate the replit-agent FAQ question 'compare to AUREM's flat tasks?'. In token mode use e.g. 'compare to AUREM's flat monthly pricing?'.
Add both strings ('flat tasks', 'task outcomes') to the forbidden-phrase list in competitors.tokenWording.test.js so this can't come back.
critical_code_review_comments: Dev-server-only, FYI: on preview the site-wide JSON-LD and og/twitter meta in index.html still say '10 tasks free', 'no token metering', 'no token billing' and 'No token meters' on every route. patchStaleTokenPhrases only runs in the build/prerender step. The production build output was clean except for the 2 'flat tasks' strings above. Preview crawlers/link-unfurlers get the legacy JSON-LD, but production won't.

patchStaleTokenPhrases uses exact-string .replace(). If anyone edits the index.html wording even slightly, the patch silently stops matching. Consider having the prerender fail the build if a forbidden phrase is still present after patching.

Wording mismatch: patchStaleTokenPhrases says 'One free full repo scan per month', while everywhere else the free tier is a single scan ('one full scan', 'Free (1 scan)', 'A free full scan'). Confirm whether the free scan really recurs monthly.
competitors.mjs is 779 lines, over the 700-line guideline. It also repeats the same TOKEN_WORDING_ACTIVE IIFE as companyInfo.mjs; consider one shared .mjs helper.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all 8 routes render, navigation passes, matrix/FAQ/CTA/about pass; 2 of 6 /vs pages have one leftover 'flat tasks' phrase)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Token mode is ON on preview via frontend/.env.development. To check the SEO artifacts without touching /app/frontend/dist: build to /tmp/fe/dist with VITE_TOKEN_BILLING_MODE=on (copy scripts, src, public and package.json, symlink node_modules), run node scripts/seo-prerender.mjs, then grep for forbidden phrases. The site-wide JSON-LD in dev-served index.html is unpatched by design, so ignore it when testing on preview.
